description: This file defines data structures and functions for parsing and handling markdown list items and lists, including methods for managing list item hierarchy, blank lines, and list parsing logic.

classes.name: ListItem
classes.description: Represents a markdown list item, including its content, indentation, and child blocks.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Represents a markdown list, including its type (ordered/unordered), children, and formatting state.

methods.name: Continuation
methods.description: Determines if a list item or list continues based on indentation and markdown content.

methods.name: AddChild
methods.description: Adds a child block (list item or list) to the current list item or list.

methods.name: AddLine
methods.description: Processes a line of markdown to determine if it affects the list or list item (e.g., blank line).

methods.name: HasTrailingBlankLine
methods.description: Checks if the list or list item has a trailing blank line.

methods.name: isLoose
methods.description: Determines if the list or list item is loose (has blank lines or spacing issues).

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Finalizes the list, setting its 'loose' state.
